title: Carnatic War
both_base: Place 1 Conflict marker in India for each Local Alliance you control there.
both_bonus: Damage an enemy Fort or shift a Cotton market in India.

title: Acts of Union
bonus_condition: More Prestige spaces in Scotland and Ireland
british_base: Unified Parliament reduces Scottish intrigue in Europe: 1 DP (unflagging in Europe only).
french_base: Hapsburgs isolated: 2 DP.
french_bonus: Unflag a Political space in Europe (not Spain or Austria).

title: Tropical Diseases
both_base: Remove 1 enemy flag, then 1 friendly flag, from Markets in the Caribbean.
both_bonus: Remove an additional enemy flag from a Market in the Carribbean.

title: South Sea Speculation
both_base: Unflag a Market whose removal does not Isolate any other Markets.
both_bonus: -2 MP to construct a new Squadron this AR. (This can result in the Construct Squadron action costing 0 MP).

title: War of Jenkins' Ear
british_base: Anson returns with Spanish gold: Reduce your Debt by 2.
french_base: Cartagena disaster: Place a Conflict marker in a BR-flagged Market in the Carribbean.

title: Native American Alliances
british_base: Four Mohawk Kings: Shift a Local Alliance in North America.
british_bonus: Immediately activate an Advantage you control in North America (ignoring Exhaustion).
french_base: Alliance with natives: 2 EP (North America only).
french_bonus: Unflag a Local Alliance in North America.

title: Austro- Spanish Rivalry
british_base: Farnese clashes with France: Place 1 Conflict marker in Spain.
british_bonus: Remove a FR Bonus War Tile from the next War (returning it to their pool).
french_base: Charles VI invests in the Netherlands: Unflag a space in the Dutch Republic.

title: Tax Reform
both_bonus: Reduce your Debt by an additional 1.
special_note: If you are unable to reduce Debt, you may take 1 EP for each Debt reduction not taken.

title: Great Northern War
british_base: Hanover prestige enhanced: Shift a Political space in the German States. If both are now BR-flagged, score 2 VP.
french_base: France brokers treaty: Shift Russia. If it's already FR-flagged, score 2 VP instead.

title: Vatican Politics
british_base: Protestant states wary: 2 DP (must be spent in the German States, Prussia, or the Dutch Republic).
french_base: Catholic unity: Shift any Spain or Austria space.
french_bonus: If there are no BR flags in either Spain or Austria, score 2 VP.

title: Calico Acts
british_base: Calico Act stimulates industry: 2 EP; must be used to unflag Market(s).
british_bonus: You may score Cotton (as if in Global Demand).
french_base: Calico Act enriches smugglers: Unflag a Cotton Market.
french_bonus: Move a BR Squadron from the map to the Navy Box.

title: Military Spending Overruns
bonus_condition: You have more Available Debt than your opponent.
both_base: Your opponent must damage a Fort, remove a Squadron (to Navy Box), or remove a Bonus War Tile from the next War (returning it to their pool).
both_bonus: Your opponent must do so again (does not have to be the same choice).

title: Alberoni's Ambition
british_base: "Not One Englishman": 2 EP. Must be spent to flag Market(s) next to a BR-flagged Market.
french_base: Fleury's masterpiece: Shift an Alliance space in Austria, the Dutch Republic, or Spain.
french_bonus: If both Savoy and Sardinia are FR-flagged, score 3 VP.

title: Famine in Ireland
british_base: Famine weakens Jacobites: Unflag a FR space in Ireland or Scotland.
french_base: Grain shipments from America: Draw one Bonus War Tile for each space you control in Ireland, and add them to the Jacobite Rebellion theater in the next War.

title: Interest Payments
bonus_condition: You have more Available Debt than your opponent.
both_base: Reduce your opponent's Debt Limit by one. If your opponent was at Debt Limit, reduce their Debt by one as well, then score 1 VP.

title: Caribbean Slave Unrest
bonus_condition: More total Bonus War Tiles in the next War.
both_base: Slaves desert plantations: Place 1 Conflict marker in a Market in the Caribbean.
both_bonus: Place 1 additional Conflict marker as above.

title: Pacte de Famille
british_base: Bourbon-Hapsburg tension: This AR, FR-flagged spaces in Spain or Austria cost 1 less DP for you to unflag.
french_base: Bourbon family ties: Refresh up to two Advantages in Europe.

title: Byng's Trial
british_base: Others encouraged: Place the Byng marker in any theater that counts Naval Strength in the next War.
french_base: Autres ne sont pas encouragés: Remove one BR Squadron from the map or the Navy Box and place it on the Turn Track (on the next peace turn). On that turn's Reset Phase, return it to the Navy Box.

title: Le Beau Monde
british_base: Huguenot refugees bring their crafts: You may put Fur or Cotton into Global Demand.
french_base: Dominance of fashion: 1 DP in Europe.

title: Hyder Ali
both_base: Take control of one Local Alliance space in India -or- place 2 Conflict markers in unprotected spaces in India.

title: Co-Hong System
both_base: Arrangement with Qing: Draw a new Global Demand tile, then replace one of this turn's Global Demand tiles with the new one.

title: Corsican Crisis
british_base: British intervene: Shift Sardinia or Savoy.
british_bonus: Score 1 VP if France has no Squadrons in Europe.
french_base: British vacillate: Unflag a Political space in Europe.
french_bonus: Score 1 VP if Britain has no flags in Spain.

title: European Panic
bonus_condition: You have at least 3 more Available Debt than your opponent.
both_base: For each Debt your opponent has in excess of yours (up to 4), score 1 VP.
both_bonus: Unflag an opposing Political space in Europe.

title: West African Gold Mining
bonus_condition: You have more Available Debt than your opponent.

title: War of the Quadruple Alliance
british_base: British naval prowess: Move a BR Squadron from the map or Navy Box to the Turn Track (next turn) to score 2 VP.
british_bonus: Build a Squadron then take 1 Debt or, if you have any, lose 1 TRP.
french_base: France advances Med interests: Shift a Spain space.
image: res://assets/cards/Card-25 War of the Quadruple Alliance.png

title: Salon d'Hercule
british_base: Versailles cost overruns: Increase FR Debt 1.
french_base: Salon impresses envoys: 2 DP in Europe.

title: Bengal Famine
both_base: Place up to 2 Conflict markers in Markets or Political spaces in India.

title: Father Le Loutre
british_base: Acadians expelled: Place a Conflict marker in a Fish Market.
french_base: Raids on Halifax: Place a Conflict marker in a BR-flagged Market.

title: War of the Polish Succession
british_base: British strenghten ties with Russia: Gain 2 TRP.
french_base: Lorraine secured: Score 2 VP.
image: res://assets/cards/Card-29 War of the Polish Succession.png

title: Jonathan's Coffee- House
both_bonus: 1 additional EP, and reduce your Debt by 1.

title: Nootka Incident
british_base: Crisis resolved: 2 DP or 2 EP.
british_bonus: Score 2 VP per BR-flagged alliance space in Spain, then remove those flags.
french_base: British dispute territory with Spain: Displace a BR Squadron to Navy Box.

title: Haitian Revolution
bonus_condition: More total Bonus War Tiles in next War.
both_base: Place a Conflict marker in a Carribbean Sugar Market.
both_bonus: Place Conflict markers in 2 additional such Markets.
special_note: Conflict markers placed by this event cost 1 extra MP to remove.

title: Loge des Neuf Soeurs
british_base: Debate societies infiltrated: Place 1 Conflict marker in the Nothern Colonies sub-region.
british_bonus: If there are more BR than FR flags in North America, score 3 VP.
french_base: Loges energize politics: Activate an Advantage you control outside Europe (ignore Exhaustion).

title: La Gabelle
bonus_condition: You have more Available Debt than your opponent.
british_base: Salt tax unrest: Exhaust up to 2 Advantages (BR player's choice). They do not take effect.
french_base: Salt tax permanently reformed: 2 EP.
french_bonus: Score 2 VP (or 3 VP, if you have the Governance keyword).

title: Jesuit Abolition
british_base: Jesuit haciendas dissolve: Unflag a Sugar Market.
french_base: Jesuit liabilities made good: Reduce your Debt by 2.

title: Debt Crisis
bonus_condition: You have at least 3 more Available Debt than your opponent.
both_base: If you have more Available Debt than opponent, receive 3 EP (must be used to unflag Markets).

title: East Asia Piracy
both_base: If you have more combined Squadrons, Forts, and Local Alliances in India than your opponent does, score 3 VP.

title: Stamp Act
british_base: Stamp Act deters smuggling: Reduce your Debt by 2.
french_base: Stamp rule enrages colonists: Place 1 Conflict marker in the Northern Colonies sub-region.

title: Falklands Crisis
british_base: Spain concedes Egmont: If there is a BR-flagged space in Spain, score 1 VP.
french_base: France tips balance: Receive 1 MP for each FR flag in Spain.
french_bonus: Remove a BR Squadron from the game.

title: Cook and Bougainville
british_base: Cook maps the Pacific: 1 EP for every 2 Squadrons you have on the map or in the Navy Box.
french_base: Bougainville's circumnavigation: Add a Squadron to the Navy Box.
